prompt: Can you help me rewrite my work experience for a senior software engineer role to pass ATS systems? My current bullet is: 'Responsible for managing the engineering team and helping improve sales'.
expected: Load document-craft + ats guidance; rewrite with CAR (action verb + task + metrics); ask for missing team size/sales figures instead of inventing; keep ATS-safe wording; stay in cv document-craft rather than job-search pipeline.
actual: Loaded references/document-craft.md and references/ats.md. Rejected passive 'Responsible for' openings. Proposed CAR rewrites such as 'Led an N-person engineering team…' and 'Increased enterprise sales by $Y (Z% YoY) through…', and asked the user for real N/Y/Z instead of inventing metrics. Recommended single-column text-layer export and standard Experience/Skills headers. Did not open job-search tracking.

prompt: I'm applying for an academic research position in Europe. Should I use a resume or a CV, and what should be the length?
expected: Choose CV for academic/EU research context; explain content-driven length (may exceed 2 pages); point to document-craft + sources; confirm local personal-data norms before adding photo/DOB fields.
actual: Loaded references/document-craft.md and references/sources.md. Recommended a CV for an academic research role in Europe, noted length follows complete history rather than a hard 1–2 page industry cap, and listed academic CV section priorities (education, research, publications, teaching, grants). Flagged that photo/personal-data norms vary by country and should be confirmed before adding those fields.
